notes: Import actual native Release screenshots from WBR_SCREENSHOT_NATIVE_DIR, with capture-source.json and medium/large subdirectories; no browser capture or synthetic resizing.
Each group imports the same five views in the listed order; filenames are captureId-view.png, preserving previous screenshot source files.
Inputs must match the configured native pixel dimensions. Alpha may be removed only when every alpha sample is fully opaque.
The app is portrait and iPhone only. Landscape and iPad assets are not included. Empty smaller iPhone slots can use App Store scaling from the current native screenshots.
